title: Internal Guidance as a Sampling Method for Tilted Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.29086v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reward guidance methods sample an exponential tilt of a base density using a diffusion model trained with only samples from the base distribution. Existing methods use what we call external guidance: additive terms in the drift or multiplicative terms on the transition probabilities. We propose internal guidance which leaves the output of the base denoiser unmodified and instead changes the point at which it is evaluated. For discrete distributions embedded in the hypercube $\{-1,1\}^{d}$, the denoiser of any linearly tilted density is exactly the base denoiser evaluated at a shifted and rescaled input. In practice the base denoiser is a neural network trained on noised samples of the base distribution. The required evaluation points for sampling the tilted density would be out-of-distribution for basic noising of the base distribution. We modify the training algorithm with random diagonal rescalings of the data, so that the denoiser n

translated_title: 内部引导：一种用于倾斜扩散模型的采样方法
translated_abstract: 奖励引导方法使用仅由基础分布样本训练的扩散模型，来对基础密度的指数倾斜分布进行采样。现有方法采用我们所说的“外部引导”：即在漂移项中加入加性项，或在转移概率上加入乘性项。我们提出了“内部引导”，它不修改基础去噪器的输出，而是改变对其求值的输入点。对于嵌入在超立方体 $\{-1,1\}^{d}$ 中的离散分布，任何线性倾斜密度的去噪器恰好等于基础去噪器在经过平移和重新缩放的输入上的求值结果。在实践中，基础去噪器是在基础分布的加噪样本上训练的神经网络。对倾斜密度进行采样所需的求值点，相对于基础分布的基本加噪过程而言超出了训练分布范围。我们通过对数据进行随机对角重缩放来修改训练算法，使去噪器能够（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出“内部引导”方法，通过改变基础去噪器的求值输入点而非修改其输出来采样倾斜密度，并利用随机对角重缩放改进训练算法，解决了所需求值点超出训练分布的问题。
